policy: Semrush BBP (hackerone.com/semrush), policy fetched 2026-08-26. RULES (law): Test only with your own account(s); no interacting with other accounts. Avoid privacy violations, destruction of data, interruption/degradation of service. Latest-version browsers only for client bugs. REFRAIN FROM: Denial of service; Spamming; Social engineering (incl. phishing) of Semrush staff/contractors; physical attempts. NOT ACCEPTED: CSRF without clear impact; issues in software not under Semrush control; Spam/SE techniques incl. SPF/DMARC/DKIM; SSL/TLS best practices without fully functional PoC; broken links (except employee social accounts - ineligible); bugs with no security risk. UNLIKELY BOUNTY: missing DNSSEC; physical-access attacks; no clear security impact (clickjacking on static site, missing security headers, HTTP methods, cookie flags, descriptive errors); brute force; password policy; CSV-injection/RFD; tabnabbing/window.opener; outdated-browser-only bugs; arbitrary text injection without HTML/JS; self-XSS / extremely-unlikely-action bugs; IDN homograph; Semrush user API-keys/creds from third-party services; third-party software bugs EXCEPT misconfigured 3rd-party services. HEADER: set 'X-hackerone: varvel' in all requests; register test accounts with @wearehackerone.com email. WAF: error 445 = WAF block; can report belief-in-bug with reasoning for whitelist consideration. Automated security scans may trigger reactive measures (account/IP block) — use conservative human-like cadence. REPORTS: 'Scanner output' or scanner-generated reports NOT accepted — every submission must be a manually-validated PoC following their template. Subdomain-takeover reports need screenshot of domain + custom HTTP content (h1 username) proving full takeover. API testing: to test auth issues change API key, not cookies. Employee creds: report compromised EMPLOYEE/service accounts (Low-Med); targeting customer accounts STRICTLY PROHIBITED; no communication with employees. 'Other Semrush Related Asset' scope: only High/Critical accepted there. FIX SLAs: Low 3mo, Medium 1mo, High/Critical ~2wk. Duplicates: first fully-reproducible report wins; one underlying issue = one bounty; bounty splitting allowed; CVSS v3.0 case-by-case; may pay more for unique/hard-to-find or high-quality reports. Disclosure per H1 guidelines; usually full disclosure after redaction. Safe harbor: research per policy = authorized incl. anti-hacking/anti-circumvention laws.

rewards.bounty: CVSS v3.0, determined by Semrush security team; bonuses for unique/high-quality
